quick.label: Tell one concrete story: who hits the problem, what happens, and what do they do today?
quick.why: A concrete story keeps the PRD about a real person and gives every later question something to be checked against.

quick.label: Who is this for?
quick.why: Decides which flows, devices and skill levels the design has to serve.

options.label: Just me or my team
options.why: We are the user, so feedback is immediate

options.label: Our existing users
options.why: A known group we can ask

options.label: A new kind of user
options.why: We have to find them first

quick.label: How much time is this worth?
quick.why: The appetite is a budget, not an estimate: the solution is shaped to fit it, and scope is cut before time is extended.

options.label: 1 day
options.why: A small, sharp fix

options.label: 1 week
options.why: One focused slice

options.label: 2 weeks
options.why: A real feature with a walking skeleton

options.label: 6 weeks
options.why: A big bet; needs hard scope cuts

quick.label: What is explicitly out of scope?
quick.why: No-gos stop agents and people from building the tempting extras; a plan without them tends to grow.

quick.label: How will we know it worked? Give a number we can check.
quick.why: Success must be checkable after shipping, so each criterion needs a measure and a threshold.

deep.why: A well-built answer to the wrong problem is the most expensive outcome; check the premise before shaping a solution.

options.label: Yes: the problem is real and worth solving now
options.why: We have evidence

options.label: Unsure: gather evidence first
options.why: A short look before committing

options.label: No: reframe the problem
options.why: Go back to the story

deep.label: What would the minimal, the ideal and a lateral solution each look like?
deep.why: Three very different shapes expose trade-offs that a single plan hides.

options.label: Minimal: the smallest thing that removes the pain
options.why: Fits the smallest appetite

options.label: Ideal: the full solution with no budget limit
options.why: Shows what we are giving up

options.label: Lateral: a different approach that avoids the problem
options.why: Sometimes the best fix is not building
